label: preparing
what: The innkeeper, builder and freight operator are coordinating a community gathering involving refreshments, deliveries and hall lighting, with 120 loaves ordered from the baker. They have disclosed a civic hospitality meeting at eighteen, but the purpose and full arrangements behind the substantial bread order remain undisclosed. The baker is supplying bread and the secretary is knowingly arranging the meeting and escort, though there is no evidence she knows any further hidden purpose.
